title: helm(private): stabilize values schema & init hooks for upgrade/rollback
author: Maya Patel
release_notes: Stabilize and tighten private Helm values schema; make init hooks idempotent and safe for upgrades/rollbacks; add validation PO checks and a migration path for older values; minor doc updates.
description: Context: customers hit a few upgrade failures when rolling Private clusters across minor releases due to Helm value shape drift and non-idempotent init hooks (postgres initjobs and kms init). This PR stabilizes the values schema, adds validation checks during chart rendering, and makes init jobs safe for repeated runs so rollback/upgrade cycles do not leave the cluster in a broken state. Motivation: reduce operational incidents and make private installer upgrades predictable for customers using pinned nodeSelectors/tolerations and KMS integrations. Summary of changes: - Add a v3-compatible values schema (values.schema.json) and integrate with helm lint and render-time validation. - Normalize encryption and kms sections so legacy keys are mapped automatically (migration helper in templates/_migrate_values.tpl). - Convert postgres backup/init to use a leader-election pre-upgrade job and make the initjob idempotent by checking for existing backups and using atomic annotations. - Add explicit nodeselector/tolerations validation and fallbacks for environments that restrict scheduling. - Add a post-upgrade cleanup job to remove temporary migration resources. - Add unit tests for template helpers and an e2e smoke test that runs an upgrade->rollback cycle in the perf-canary cluster. Checklist: [x] values.schema.json added and validated with helm-docs [x] init jobs made idempotent [x] migration helper for legacy KMS/encryption values [x] CI: helm lint + unit tests + e2e smoke passing [x] Docs: private/upgrade.md updated Testing and QA: Local helm template/dry-run across the supported value permutations and a canary run on the perf-canary cluster (upgrade from v2025.10 -> v2025.11 then rollback). Observability: added a metric to track migration job runs and a log field to correlate init job executions to a release tag. Rollback plan: Because the changes are backward-compatible at the chart level and the init hooks are idempotent, downgrades should be safe. The migration helper writes a marker annotation so older charts can skip migration on rollback. If an issue is observed, the safe path is: 1) revert the chart to previous release, 2) run the manual cleanup job (doc steps in private/upgrade.md), 3) open a support ticket referencing SUP-1245. Notes: This PR intentionally avoids changing CRD shapes; CRD migrations are out-of-scope and will be handled in a follow-up.
commits_summary: 4 commits: consolidate values schema and helpers; add migration template and tests; make initjobs idempotent with leader-election; docs and smoke test for canary upgrade/rollback.
diff_snippets: + values.schema.json: add required/encryption/kms shape and nodeselector/tolerations validations
+ _migrate_values.tpl: helper to map legacy kms keys and write migration annotation
- init-postgres-backup.yaml: replace non-idempotent job with leader-election pre-upgrade job (idempotent checks)
+ migration-cleanup-job.yaml: post-upgrade cleanup to remove temp resources
